# react-timecalendar

> Lightweight, typed React date and time-slot picker for booking and appointment UIs. Pass opening hours and existing bookings in, get the selected `Date` back. ~6 KB minified plus date-fns v4. React 16.8–19. MIT.

Use it when you need "pick a day, then pick an available 30-minute slot" and existing bookings must be greyed out. Do not use it for full scheduling grids (see react-big-calendar) or plain date pickers (see react-day-picker).

## Install

    npm install react-timecalendar date-fns

## Minimal usage

    import TimeCalendar from "react-timecalendar";
    <TimeCalendar openHours={[[9, 17]]} timeSlot={30} onTimeClick={(t: Date) => save(t)} />

## Key props

- openHours: number[][] — [open, close] in 24h decimal. 1 entry = every day, 2 = weekday/weekend, 7 = Sunday-first per day. Required for the time view.
- timeSlot: number — slot length in minutes, default 30.
- bookings: { id, start_time, end_time }[] — Date, epoch ms or ISO-8601 string. In day view, slots from start_time (inclusive) to end_time (exclusive) render disabled. In month view without openHours, every calendar day the booking touches renders disabled (a booking ending at 00:00 still blocks that day).
- onDateClick(day: Date), onTimeClick(time: Date)
- startTime / endTime: Date | epoch ms | ISO string | "" — multi-slot range to highlight; the component does not enforce it, your onTimeClick does.
- selectedDate / onSelectedDateChange, view ("month" | "day") / onViewChange — controlled; defaultSelectedDate / defaultView for uncontrolled initial state.
- disableHistory (default true), clickable (default true).

All times are browser-local Dates. Styles are injected on import; class names are documented in README.md under "Styling".
